item.title: Refund Request
item.body: Dear TRAE Support Team, This is a follow-up reminder for my refund application submitted on April 20, 2026. I have not received any reply from your team for more than 48 hours. My account details: User ID: 7628729716514980885 Payment email: yujiechang123@gmail.com Total payment amount: USD 90.00 Payment time: April 20, 2026 I solemnly and legally confirm: I have NEVER logged in, activated, used or enjoyed ANY paid subscription services & content of TRAE after this purchase. This subscription is 100% completely unused. According to your official public refund policy (https://docs.trae.ai/ide/billing): Unused Pro subscription within refund period is eligible for FULL refund. I fully meet all legal and official refund conditions. Payment receipt screenshot is attached. Your team has exceeded normal reply time. Please process my full USD 90 refund immediately within 24 hours, and reply with refund progress & completion time. If I still receive no response or refusal, I will submit official complaints through payment channel appeal, GitHub public issue platform, consumer rights protection channels and social media exposure. Best regards, Yujie Chang yujiechang123@gmail.com
